name: Download and inspect 1B GGUF
command:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net '~/pulsar-rpi/v/bin/python - <<"PY" 2>&1 | tail -16
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
import struct
p = snapshot_download("google/gemma-3-1b-it-qat-q4_0-gguf", allow_patterns=["gemma-3-1b-it-q4_0.gguf"])
print("SNAP:", p, flush=True)
import glob, os
f = glob.glob(p + "/*.gguf")[0]
print("SIZE-MB:", os.path.getsize(f) // 1048576, flush=True)
b = open(f, "rb")
magic, ver, nt, na = struct.unpack("<IIII", b.read(16))
print("magic:", hex(magic), "ver:", ver, "tensors:", nt, "meta:", na, flush=True)
# walk metadata (KV) to find arch + key dims
import sys
def rd_str():
    n = struct.unpack("<Q", b.read(8))[0]
    return b.read(n).decode("utf-8", "replace")
def rd_val(t):
    if t == 8: return rd_str()
    if t == 4: return struct.unpack("<I", b.read(4))[0]
    if t == 6: return struct.unpack("<f", b.read(4))[0]
    if t == 7: return struct.unpack("<B", b.read(1))[0]
    if t == 9:
        at = struct.unpack("<I", b.read(4))[0]
        return [rd_val(at) for _ in range(struct.unpack("<Q", b.read(8))[0])]
    raise ValueError(t)
want = ("general.architecture", "gemma3.embedding_length", "gemma3.block_count",
        "gemma3.feed_forward_length", "gemma3.attention.head_count",
        "gemma3.attention.head_count_kv", "tokenizer.ggml.model")
for _ in range(na):
    klen = struct.unpack("<Q", b.read(8))[0]
    k = b.read(klen).decode("utf-8", "replace")
    t = struct.unpack("<I", b.read(4))[0]
    try: v = rd_val(t)
    except: print("SKIP", k, t, flush=True); break
    if k in want or k.startswith("tokenizer") and len(k) < 40: print(k, "=", v, flush=True)
PY' 2>&1 | head -18
